messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final pass on Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy. Need hero + subhead + 3 bullets each, bench callout, webinar CTA, and inbound routing hooks for sales. Thoughts?
Ian: For Hosted hero: 'Ship LLM features fast — hosted API with predictable latency and simple SDKs.' Subhead idea: 'Start with free credits, scale to dedicated when you need predictable throughput.' Bench: show tokens/sec and $/1M tokens vs self-host. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Sofia: +1. For Dedicated emphasize 'reserved GPU pools, SLA-backed latency' and note burst capacity. Add a line about model pinning & rollout controls. For Private: 'VPC or on‑prem with audit logs + KMS' — compliance-first phrasing.
Devon: How many words for hero/subhead? Keep hero ~8-10 words, subhead one sentence. Bullets should be short (6–10 words). We'll need variants for mobile.
Maya: Good. Can we produce 2 variants per page? 1) Technical (engineer-focused) and 2) Product (PM/ops) — quick A/B.
Lee: Inbound routing: Hosted = instant signup + playground. Dedicated/Private should surface a gated demo request. Add hidden lead params: company_size, infra_tag, intent_signal. If lead_score > 80 route to AE (sales).
Ian: Bench narrative: lead with 99th perc latency and per-token unit economics. Call out caching + batching impact. Example copy: 'Using prefix cache + batching reduced token spend by 3x at 95th percentile workloads.'
Sofia: We can't use specific customer names. Use anonymized examples: 'a fintech startup' or 'marketplace app'. Short quote option: 'Cut inference cost by 3x with batching + cache.'
Maya: Drafts incoming — first pass hero snippets below. Please flag edits:
Maya: Hosted (technical) hero: `High-throughput hosted API — ~10–30ms per token median, SDKs in Python + TS`
Maya: Hosted (product) hero: `Ship features fast with a production-ready hosted API`
Maya: Dedicated hero: `Reserved capacity with SLA-backed latency and burst`
Maya: Private hero: `Private deployment: VPC, KMS, and audit-ready logging`
Devon: Lgtm but be careful with precise latency numbers. Maybe use ranges and qualifiers: `~10–30ms median per token depending on model/seq length`. OpsBot: compliance note?
OpsBot: Reminder — any copy that mentions 'air-gapped' or specific security configurations requires legal + security review before publish.
Lee: CTA matrix: Hosted = 'Get started' (self-serve). Dedicated = 'Request pricing' (form). Private = 'Contact sales' (AE). Add mid-funnel: 'Request benchmark whitepaper' gated form.
Ian: For the benchmark section: include a simple table (tokens/s, median latency, $/1M tokens) and a short explainer on how caching and quantization affect cost.
Sofia: For rollout messaging add one-line about 'pin model versions & safe canary rollouts' and a micro-example for engineers.
Maya: Webinar tie-in: run a webinar that foregrounds the benchmark stories + customer anonymized reductions. Who speaks? Sofia + Ian + infra PM.
Ian: Webinar title option: 'Serving LLMs at Product Scale — tradeoffs, benchmarks, and configs'. Brief agenda: 1) benchmarks 2) deployment patterns (hosted vs dedicated vs private) 3) optimization knobs 4) Q&A.
Sofia: I'll prep a short demo: Dedicated rollout example + fallback to hosted variant + brief quantization explainer slide.
Devon: I'll build hero comps for both variants — need final copy strings by EOD to finish designs.
Maya: Timeline: drafts by EOD today, internal review tomorrow AM, assets to site by EOW. I'll assemble the two variants, bench callout, CTA matrix, and a wireframe for the benchmark section.
Lee: Also add a quick sales play: recommended lead qualification questions for the form and a short email template AE can use when a high-intent lead comes in.
Maya: Great — I'll add form fields: company_name, company_size_range, infra_preference (hosted/dedicated/private), monthly_tokens_est, contact_role. Thanks everyone :pray:
Devon: Will need copy length limits for mobile. Ping me in the doc if anything changes.
Maya: Ok locking this thread — I'll post the draft file link when uploaded to Figma.
